rv.q: Its World Premiere production at International City Theatre is one worth cheering.
Playwright Webb’s determination to slice into the thick skin of stereotypes is what gives his play its character and redeems it in much the way that it redeems David.

cn.t: Webb's new play about forgiveness doesn't fully succeed in all aspects, but delivers a powerful, cathartic climax through its ambitious juxtaposition of WWII Poland and post-9/11 New York.
